text: One July day, a woman named Frau Troffea stepped into the street, and began to dance.
Within a week, thirty more had joined her.
By the end of summer, some accounts say four hundred people were dancing.
The city's doctors had a cure: more dancing.
So they hired musicians, and built a stage.
It only made things worse. Dancers collapsed in the streets.
At last, they were carried to a mountain shrine, to pray.
To this day, nobody knows why it started.
